title: tap: Mark filtered packets instead of dropping them
description: The tap system filters packets which do not apply to the display filter. This will prevent implementations, where this information can be used to provide additional information to the enduser, e.g. a total count. With this change, packets to be filtered are not filtered but rather marked as such and it is the obligation of the display tool to filter out any packets not to be displayed.

commits_data.message:
tap: Mark filtered packets instead of dropping them

Allows packets to be filtered but marked and not removed from the
tap listing. Additionally a total is calculated for all rx/tx frames
and bytes
